checks.name: Five original emblems are distinct nonempty bounded rasters
HUD and guide share one cached texture per ability
Unknown abilities do not invent a fallback meaning
Ready cooling and unavailable emblems contrast with both combat surfaces
Inline emblems fit without replacing or overlapping names (960, 540)
Guide keys names and matching selected emblem fit with native focus (960, 540)
Inline emblems fit without replacing or overlapping names (1280, 720)
Guide keys names and matching selected emblem fit with native focus (1280, 720)
Real reload is a cooling emblem with explicit RELOADING text
Accepted kit cooldown changes emblem and retains the remaining seconds
Paused abilities retain names and use unavailable emblems
Reduced options preserve static recognition and live receiver semantics
Absent receiver stays disabled and decorative icons add no focus stop

scope: Headless actual world/guide state and viewport-dispatched keys, cached original SVG rasters, contrast and geometry. No OS input or rendered appearance acceptance.
